name: Variación Total
description: Mide la norma de variación total para detectar suavidad antinatural o regularidad excesiva en imágenes generadas por IA.
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis Total Variation Norm Analysis
mechanism:
Este método applies Total Variation (TV) analysis following Rudin, Osher & Fatemi (1992) for forensic image assessment:

1. **Total Variation Cálculo**: The isotropic TV of the image I is computed as TV(I) = Σ√(|∂I/∂x|² + |∂I/∂y|²), measuring the total amount of spatial variation. This L¹ norm of the gradient penalizes oscillations while preserving edges — making it sensitive to the difference between natural and synthetic image characteristics.

2. **Local TV Mapeo**: A spatial map of local TV values computed in sliding windows reveals the distribution of image complexity. Natural images show physically coherent TV variation — smooth regions (low TV), edges (moderate TV), and textures (high TV) arranged in semantically meaningful patterns.

3. **TV Regularity Análisis**: The ratio of TV to image energy (TV/‖I‖₂) provides a normalized smoothness measure. generado por IA images often exhibit characteristic TV profiles: diffusion models tend toward overly smooth interiors with sharp boundaries, while GANs may produce micro-oscillations elevating TV in supposedly smooth regions.

4. **Anisotropic TV Descomposición**: The directional components TV_x and TV_y are analyzed separately. Natural images show orientation-dependent TV variation correlated with scene geometry. generado por IA images may exhibit isotropic TV even in scenes that should show strong directional bias (e.g., architectural images).

5. **Chambolle Projection Análisis**: Using Chambolle's (2004) dual formulation, the TV-minimizing reconstruction is computed. The difference between the original and TV-denoised image isolates the texture/noise component. Analysis of this component reveals whether the fine-scale structure follows natural sensor noise statistics or exhibits generación de IA artifacts.
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
